newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CONTROVERSIAL REF REMOVED FROM CHELSEA RE-MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CONTROVERSIAL REF REMOVED FROM CHELSEA RE-MATCH.

text.p: The referee who awarded Chelsea the controversial penalty that knocked Leicester out of the English F.A. Cup last week will not take charge of the premier league match between the two sides on April 19.

Referee Mike Reed awarded a penalty three minutes from the end of injury time in a fifth round replay last Wednesday when he adjudged that Matt Elliot had fouled Erland Johnsen. Video evidence clearly suggested otherwise.
His car was attacked as he left Stamford Bridge and there was concern that his presence for the league game between the teams might prove provocative.
Mike Lee, the premier league spokesman, said on Wednesday the decision had not been prompted by the police but had been arrived at after discussions with "various interested parties.".
Reed had been informed and was happy with the decision.
